title: DCP Multi-Harmonic Weighted Fisher Decoder Audit: Exact Parseval Mean-Square Visibility Law, Zero-Lag Inversion Identity, and Matched-Filter Optimality

theorems.name: Exact Sum of Non-Zero Harmonic Visibilities via K_eta(0)
theorems.statement: For any symmetric probability distribution K_eta on Z_q, the sum of non-zero harmonic visibilities lambda_d = sum_e K_eta(e) cos(2*pi*d*e/q) over d in {1, ..., q-1} equals q * K_eta(0) - 1.

theorems.name: Exact Parseval Collision-Purity Law for Quadratic Visibility
theorems.statement: For any symmetric probability distribution K_eta on Z_q, the sum of squared non-zero harmonic visibilities over d in {1, ..., q-1} equals q * sum_(e in Z_q) K_eta(e)^2 - 1.

theorems.name: Cauchy-Schwarz Matched-Filter Optimality and Physical-Space SNR Gap Identity
theorems.statement: Matched-harmonic weighting w_d* = lambda_d maximizes SNR(w; K_eta) at SNR_matched = q * sum_e K_eta(e)^2 - 1, exceeding uniform weighting SNR_unif = (q * K_eta(0) - 1)^2 / (q - 1) by exactly q * sum_(e=1)^(q-1) (K_eta(e) - (1 - K_eta(0))/(q - 1))^2 >= 0.
